name: ca77y-engineering
description: Idea-to-shipped development pipeline: analyst, the lead skill (run in the main session, takes one task end to end — no splitting), the board skill (resolves how the project tracks work — repo files, a hosted tracker, or nothing — into a board profile the pipeline works from), coder, qa (validation plus the local code review), writer (specs + docs), auditor. Research and the Markdown research library live in the companion ca77y-library plugin, used when installed. Root manifest mirrors .claude-plugin/plugin.json.
